note: Hand-assigned categories of the development disagreements between the Part 102 engine and the 19 CFR 102.20 check, written before any D590 variant was run. One primary category per row: classification (the engine's classification of the good or a material differs from the codes the rule reads; plan facts do not state them), assembly (the engine treats assembling or simple assembly as a reason a material fails, citing 102.17, which does not list it, under a row that does not name it), invented_exception (the engine adds an exception the row does not have), rule_input (the rule's own input, a suggested code, is the likely error; the engine gives CBP's answer or a defensible reading). cites_assembly_or_102_17: the engine's reasoning on that row also calls the work simple or minor assembly or non-qualifying under 102.17.
